new_events.actor: Saudi Aramco / Gulf of Oman tanker market / Kpler
new_events.summary: Reuters reported ship-to-ship crude transfers in the Gulf of Oman had reached capacity limits as Saudi Arabia shifted more exports through Hormuz after disruption to the Red Sea route. Kpler put Saudi crude exports via Hormuz on track for about 3.6 million bpd in September versus about 900,000 bpd in August, raising VLCC demand and freight costs.

Turkey's parliament speaker said the Saudi-Pakistan-Turkiye defence pact could eventually broaden into a wider Muslim-world framework that includes Iran. This was a political possibility statement, not an Iranian accession, formal invitation or treaty amendment.

The U.S. ambassador to China said President Trump reiterated to Xi Jinping that direct or indirect Chinese help to Iran, including intelligence, parts or military equipment, was unacceptable and said Washington received assurances from Beijing. The scope and implementation of any Chinese commitment were not independently established at this horizon.

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters/Kpler preliminary data put Thursday Sep.24 Strait of Hormuz commodity-vessel transits at nine, down from 14 the previous day and below a 10-day average of 18. Eight of the nine were exits. AIS-dark traffic remained an explicit undercount caveat.

Reuters/Kpler reported 33.7 million barrels of crude had exited Hormuz so far in the week beginning Sep.20 on 19 tankers. This weekly crude-volume series is retained separately from daily visible commodity-vessel counts.

UNICEF said nearly 130,000 people, including about 71,000 children, had been displaced over three weeks. Of nearly 2,900 children screened by mobile nutrition teams in accessible areas, more than one in four were acutely malnourished and over 200 had severe acute malnutrition. UNICEF had verified 15 children killed and 14 injured since Sep.3, with three reported missing. The agency also said 243 schools had closed or suspended learning, affecting more than 137,000 students. IOM described roughly 130,000 displaced; preserve agency/timebox differences rather than forcing a single denominator.

economic_energy_updates.observed_state: Kpler/Reuters said Saudi crude exports through Hormuz were on track for about 3.6 million bpd in September versus about 900,000 bpd in August, with Gulf of Oman STS capacity constraints and record freight pressure.
